sources.title: Muse Glimmer - Meta
sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.

sources.title: Model API - dev.meta.ai
sources.snippet: Adapt Muse Glimmer to your domain with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on your own labeled examples. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is the recommended approach: it trains a small set of adapter weights while keeping the base model frozen, reducing GPU memory requirements by an order of magnitude.Fine-tuning is the first stage of customization.
